editionLabel: Indie Boards & Cards English revised edition
firstPlayerRule: The players decide together who goes first. If they cannot decide, the youngest player starts.
houseFallback: If the group cannot decide and the youngest players are tied, choose randomly among the tied players.
clarifications: The same opening rule applies to the Family and Experienced games.
